name: PCHEM
recent: PETRONAS Chemicals 近期公告以 EPF 的股东权益变动申报为主，另于 10 月 2 日公布董事局变动，委任 Izwan Ismail 为董事经理兼首席执行官，自 2027 年 1 月 1 日起生效。最新财报显示 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度营收环比增长 12.7%、同比增长 22.8%，净利环比增长 3.2%，净利率为 5.2%。
notable: 委任 Izwan Ismail 为董事经理兼首席执行官，自 2027 年 1 月 1 日起生效。
EPF 在 2026 年 9 月至 11 月期间多次申报作为大股东的权益变动。
risks: EPF 在 2026 年 9 月至 11 月期间多次申报权益变动，显示大股东持股出现变动。
earnings: 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度营收为 MYR 7,903 百万，环比增长 12.7%，同比增长 22.8%；净利为 MYR 414 百万，环比增长 3.2%；净利率为 5.2%，上一季度为 5.7%。

recent_en: PETRONAS Chemicals' recent announcements were mainly EPF's substantial shareholder filings, plus a boardroom change on 2 October 2026 appointing Izwan Ismail as Managing Director and CEO effective 1 January 2027. The latest results for the quarter ended 30 June 2026 showed revenue up 12.7% QoQ and 22.8% YoY, net income up 3.2% QoQ, with a net margin of 5.2%.
notable_en: Izwan Ismail appointed as Managing Director and CEO effective 1 January 2027.
EPF filed multiple substantial shareholder changes between September and November 2026.
risks_en: EPF filed multiple substantial shareholder changes between September and November 2026, indicating changes in major shareholder holdings.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 7,903 million, up 12.7% QoQ and 22.8% YoY; net income was MYR 414 million, up 3.2% QoQ; net margin was 5.2% versus 5.7% in the prior quarter.
